description: Follow directories an instrument writes to: each call looks once and returns events since cursor (dataset_new, plane_new, scan_new, frame_new, dataset_complete, dataset_stalled, qc with qc=true: saturation, focus drift, dropped frames, TIC drop, error). Poll with the returned cursor; files are never locked.

cursor.description: Return events with a sequence number greater than this (the `cursor` of the previous call); 0 or absent on the first call.

dirs.description: Directories (or files) to watch. The same list (in any order) continues the same watcher across calls.

follow_symlinks.description: First call only: walk into directories behind symbolic links too (links to files are always followed).

limit.description: Most events returned (default 200, max 5000); call again with the new cursor for more.

qc.description: First call only: evaluate the built-in live QC rules on each new plane or scan.

since.description: First call only: report data sets modified since then (`10m`, `2h`, `1d`, an ISO-8601 time, or `all`). Default: the live window (5 minutes) back from now.

stall_after.description: First call only: seconds without growth before `dataset_stalled` (default 120).

name: openreadout_watch

ErrorBody.description: Structured error body. `hint` is meant to be actionable by an agent.

code.description:
Stable code: `unknown_format`, `unsupported_feature`, `corrupt_file`, `usage`, `io`, `error`,
`internal_panic` (a bug: the tool panicked; please report it).

exit_code.description: The process exit code for this error (see the crate docs).

hint.description: What to try next, when the tool knows.

oneOf.description: A data set was seen for the first time (or reappeared).
A new sweep (frame) of a trace: electrophysiology sweeps, NMR FIDs.
The data set is finished: every end-of-file structure is written and it stopped changing.
A data set still being written has not grown for `stall_after` (or was interrupted).
A data set could not be read.

Fraction of samples at the detector's ceiling (recorded bit depth, else the pixel
type's maximum).
Plane sharpness relative to the first planes of the same image and channel.
Gap before a new time point relative to the median gap.
MS1 total ion current relative to the first MS1 scans.

saturation_level.description:
`saturated_fraction` only: the sample value counted as saturated (2^bits − 1 from the
file's recorded bit depth, else the pixel type's maximum).

expected.description: Planes the finished data set will hold, when known.

idle_s.description: Seconds since the data set last grew (`dataset_stalled`).

index.description: Zero-based position of the plane, scan or sweep among those reported for the data set.

mtime.description: Modification time of the data set (ISO-8601 UTC).

path.description: The data set (a file, or a directory store).

seq.description: Sequence number, increasing by one per event within a watcher (the MCP cursor).

size_bytes.description: Size of the data set in bytes when the event was produced.

ts.description: When the event was emitted (ISO-8601 UTC, milliseconds).

cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to get only newer events.

dropped.description: True when events after the cursor were dropped (the server keeps the last 10000).

events.description:
Events after the given cursor, oldest first (the same objects `openreadout watch`
prints under `data`).

more.description: True when more events are waiting (raise `limit` or call again).

notes.description: What the watcher left out and how to include it.
